gaps.sentence: It was ___ of you to double-check the figures (SENSE).
gaps.explanation: 'It was sensible of you to do something' praises good judgement; 'sensitive' means easily affected.
'Beyond recognition' is the fixed phrase; after 'beyond' a noun is needed.

gaps.sentence: He ___ denied knowing anything about the plan (FIRM).
gaps.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb 'denied': firmly. Note the doubled m before -ly.

gaps.sentence: The storm caused serious ___ (DESTROY) along the coast.
gaps.explanation: After the adjective 'serious' a noun is needed: destruction (-tion noun).

gaps.sentence: It is ___ to smoke inside public buildings (LEGAL).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed: against the law (il-)
gaps.explanation: The negative of 'legal' is 'illegal' (il- before l). An adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.sentence: The treaty will strengthen economic ___ between the two countries (COOPERATE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is followed by a noun: cooperation (-tion noun).

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ until Thursday (SCHEDULE).
gaps.hint: arranged for a new time (re-); past participle needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again/afresh: rescheduled means given a new time. The passive needs the past participle.

gaps.sentence: The team played ___ and deserved to win (EXCELLENT).
gaps.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb 'played': excellently (-ly).
